content_sections.text: Other conditions: Only women candidates are eligible Residence and caste certificates must be issued online by the tehsil with digital signature and be verifiable online Income certificate must be online-verifiable and within three years of issue as of 26-11-2026 Two women of one family will not be appointed at one Anganwadi centre

content_sections.heading: How Will ICDS Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Selection as per the Government Order dated 17-09-2025 Merit prepared on the basis of educational qualification up to a maximum of postgraduate Preference by category of woman of the same gram sabha / ward, then category-wise selection from the concerned Nyay Panchayat First preference: widow / legally divorced / abandoned woman of a BPL family resident of the same gram sabha / ward Next: women of BPL families of the same gram sabha / ward If none is eligible in the gram sabha, category-wise selection from the concerned Nyay Panchayat

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of documents mentioned in the online form, clean and legible Income, caste and residence certificates issued by 26-11-2026 High School marksheet and certificate (date of birth) Widows: death certificate from Gram Panchayat Officer / urban body and certified copy of family register Divorced / abandoned women: legal order issued by the court

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICDS Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Fill the application online on https://upanganwadibharti.in in the format available there, correctly and carefully. Upload self-attested, clean and legible copies of the documents mentioned in the online form. Apply by 26-11-2026, midnight 12.00; offline applications are not accepted under any circumstances. Read the Government Order dated 17-09-2025 before applying.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Any error, or wrong or forged data or marks, will cancel the candidature Gram sabha / ward-wise vacancy details with reservation are on office notice boards and https://upanganwadibharti.in The right to cancel any selection rests with the selection committee / appointing authority The number of advertised posts may decrease or increase

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ICDS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ICDS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 242 vacancies: 20 Anganwadi Worker (Bairia), 5 Anganwadi Worker (Bansdih), 8 Anganwadi Worker (Belhari), 9 Anganwadi Worker (Beruarbari), 3 Anganwadi Worker (City), 21 Anganwadi Worker (Chilkahar) and 12 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ICDS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 35 years (as on 1 July 2026).

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Intermediate or equivalent (minimum). Merit is prepared on the basis of educational qualification up to a maximum of postgraduate. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only women candidates are eligible. Residence and caste certificates must be issued online by the tehsil with digital signature and be verifiable online. Income certificate must be online-verifiable and within three years of issue as of 26-11-2026. Two women of one family will not be appointed at one Anganwadi centre.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Selection as per the Government Order dated 17-09-2025. Merit prepared on the basis of educational qualification up to a maximum of postgraduate. Preference by category of woman of the same gram sabha / ward, then category-wise selection from the concerned Nyay Panchayat. First preference: widow / legally divorced / abandoned woman of a BPL family resident of the same gram sabha / ward.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Ballia district: 18 Child Development Projects (Bairia, Bansdih, Belhari, Beruarbari, City, Chilkahar, Dubhad, Garwar, Hanumanganj, Maniar, Murlichhapra, Nagra, Navanagar, Pandah, Rasra, Reoti, Siyar, Sohav).

faq.question: Q9. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Self-attested copies of documents mentioned in the online form, clean and legible; Income, caste and residence certificates issued by 26-11-2026; High School marksheet and certificate (date of birth); Widows: death certificate from Gram Panchayat Officer / urban body and certified copy of family register; Divorced / abandoned women: legal order issued by the court.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The notification describes the engagement as: Contract.
